title: Stasis Portal Encounter
description: A black and white woman wearing a cage-like mask and patterned dress stands at an open doorway labeled 'STASIS', reaching toward a vibrant red three-eyed figure emerging from a framed portal. The red figure has a planet with rings and tiny figures on its head, a spherical chest emblem containing smaller figures, and is surrounded by floating alien faces, geometric shapes, and tentacles against a dark background.
prompt: A surreal scene in a dark void, a woman in black and white with a cage mask and patterned dress stands at an open doorway labeled STASIS reaching toward a bright red three-eyed alien figure emerging from a rectangular portal frame. The red figure has a saturn-like planet with rings and tiny figures for a head, a circular chest emblem showing smaller people inside, surrounded by floating smiling alien faces, lavender sprigs, geometric triangles, and writhing tentacles. High contrast black and white linework with selective vibrant red coloring, mystical and eerie atmosphere.
